<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks at 169.52, 132.43, 130.27, 129.30, 126.70, 126.66, 123.57, 43.30, and 26.29 ppm. Methyl carbons typically appear upfield around 10–30 ppm. Only the peak at 26.29 ppm falls within this range, indicating a single methyl (CH₃) group.</thought>
